verdict.rationale: Viam's module docs explicitly list "Schedule actions" and "Run continuous processes" as purposes of logic modules. That makes recurring work a documented, first-party pattern. However, it is code you write inside a module rather than a dedicated scheduler or workflow feature. missing for 10: a built-in job or workflow scheduler (cron-style recurring triggers configurable in the app, CLI or API), documentation of schedule configuration and run history, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
